parameters_sar_values

parameters_sar_values.Rmd
library(RFDose)

More information about parameters and SAR values will be added here.

Parameters

Parameters are specified in YAML files: params.yaml for all parameters except SAR values, and a SAR file for the SAR values (sar_goliat_average.yaml by default, see GOLIAT SAR values). Parameters are obtained from measurements, dosimetric simulations, and literature- more detailed descriptions of each parameter, including units and data sources, will be included in Jalilian et al. (manuscript in preparation).

GOLIAT SAR values

The GOLIAT SAR files (inst/extdata/sar_goliat_*.yaml) contain SAR values from GOLIAT dosimetric simulations, used instead of the ETAIN SAR values (sar_etain.yaml). There is one file per phantom (Duke, Ella, Eartha, Thelonious) and one with the average of the four phantoms (sar_goliat_average.yaml), which is the default. The files are generated by data-raw/source-sar-goliat/sar_goliat.R from the GOLIAT results file (Final_Data_All_2026_LAST.xlsx, not included in this repository), which is read by data-raw/source-sar-goliat/reading_raw_goliat_sar.R.
